app.name: Sunfleck
app.tagline: Plant care for your home and garden

roles.adminDescription: Everything, plus managing the household and its members
roles.gardenerDescription: Add and edit plants, log care

setup.title: Welcome to Sunfleck
setup.intro: Let's create your account. You'll be the Admin of your household and can invite others later.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.noAccount: No account? Ask your household's Admin for an invitation.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.intro: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for {{email}}, a link is on its way. No email arriving? Your household's Admin can create a reset link for you.

invite.title: Join {{household}}
invite.intro: {{inviter}} invited you to Sunfleck as a {{role}}. Create your account to get started.
invite.introNoInviter: You've been invited to Sunfleck as a {{role}}. Create your account to get started.
invite.invalid: This invitation link is invalid, already used, or expired. Ask your household's Admin for a new one.

home.placesCta: Start by telling Sunfleck where your plants live.
home.plantsCta: Add your plants, with photos, to start keeping track of them.

places.title: Places
places.intro: Where your plants live: your home, garden, or allotment, and the rooms and beds in them.
places.empty: No places yet. Add your home to get started.
places.whereHelp: Used for weather, frost warnings, and daylight. Tap the map, use your current location, or type the coordinates.
places.locationUnavailable: Your browser couldn't tell us where you are. Tap the map or type the coordinates instead.
places.mapLabel: Map: tap to set the location
places.timezoneHelp: Decides when a new day starts for reminders.
places.deleteSiteConfirm: Its locations, windows, and grow lights will be deleted too. Their plants are kept, without a location.
places.noLocations: No locations yet. Add a room, shelf, bed, or balcony.
places.exposureFullSun: Full sun (6+ hours of direct sun)
places.deleteLocationConfirm: Its windows and grow lights will be deleted too. Its plants are kept, without a location.
places.lightIntro: Windows and grow lights help Sunfleck predict how much light your plants get.
places.noLight: No windows or grow lights yet.
places.directionHelp: Stand at the window and look out: which way are you facing?
places.brightnessHelp: Not sure? Choose a shelf light; you can change it any time. Values are in µmol/m²/s, about 30 cm (12 in) below the light.
places.ppfdHelp: In µmol/m²/s. The light's manual or the maker's website may list it at a given height.
places.dliPreview: About {{dli}} mol/m²/day of light ({{hours}} hours a day).
places.dliGuide: Rough guide: low-light plants need 3–6, most houseplants 6–12, succulents and vegetables 15 or more.
places.windowPlantsNote: When you add a plant, you'll say how far it is from this window.
places.plantsToMoveHelp: Plants without a location are listed first.
places.noPlantsToMove: All your plants are here already, or have no care now (given away or died).
places.movedChooseLight_one: On its page, choose which windows and grow lights reach it here.
places.movedChooseLight_other: On each plant's page, choose which windows and grow lights reach it here.

plants.title: Plants
plants.empty: No plants yet. Add your first one!
plants.name: Name
plants.locationHelp: Where it lives. Add rooms and beds under Places.
plants.noLocationsYet: You haven't added any places yet.
plants.potSizeHelp: Used to work out how much water to give. Without a height, Sunfleck assumes a standard pot, about as tall as it is wide.
plants.whichLightsHelp: Tick the windows and grow lights it gets light from.
plants.noLightsInLocation: This location has no windows or grow lights yet.
plants.addLightsHint: Add them on the location's page.
plants.outdoorLight: Outdoors, light comes from the location's sun exposure.
plants.noLightReaches: No windows or grow lights reach it.
plants.choosePhotoHelp: Optional. You can add more later.
plants.deletePlantConfirm: Its photos will be deleted too. If it died or you gave it away, you can change its status instead and keep its history.
plants.caption: Caption

care.howWasSoilHelp: Before watering. This helps Sunfleck learn when this plant needs water.
care.skippedLabel: I checked, but didn't need to
care.skippedHelp: For example, the soil was still wet.

settings.title: Care types
settings.intro: The kinds of care you can log. Add your own for anything the built-in ones don't cover.
settings.name: Name
settings.deleteConfirm: You can only delete care types that haven't been used.
settings.countsAsWateringHelp: Updates when a plant was last watered, and asks how the soil was. For example, bottom watering.

guide.title: Care guide
guide.intro: Typical care for groups of plants. Sunfleck starts from these and learns from each plant's history.
guide.noResults: No plants found. Try the scientific name, or pick a care profile below.
guide.noProfile: No care profile yet. Choose its species, or a care profile, when you edit it.

letDry.top_quarter: when the top quarter of the soil is dry
letDry.top_third: when the top third of the soil is dry
letDry.top_half: when the top half of the soil is dry
letDry.mostly: when the soil is mostly dry
letDry.completely: when the soil is completely dry

lightLevel.someSun: Bright light with some direct sun

guide.draftHelp: These are reasonable starting values, not yet checked against cited sources. Sunfleck adjusts them for each plant as it learns.
guide.careProfileHelp: Optional. Choose one if you don't know the species, or it needs different care.
guide.notFound: This plant or care profile doesn't exist.

schedules.title: Care schedule
schedules.suggestedIntro: Based on its care profile, where it grows and its pot. Pick what you'd like reminders for; you can change it any time.
schedules.noProfileHint: Choose its species or a care profile to get watering and fertilizing predicted.
schedules.noSuggestions: Nothing to suggest. Add a schedule for any care you'd like reminders for.
schedules.predictedHelp: Sunfleck works out when it's needed from its care profile, light, pot and your feedback.
schedules.cantPredict: Only watering and fertilizing can be predicted, and only for plants with a care profile.
schedules.inUseHelp: Pause it to stop being reminded, without losing it.
schedules.deleteConfirm: Your care history stays. You can add the schedule again later.

factors.season_one: {{season}}: about every day for its care profile
factors.season_other: {{season}}: about every {{count}} days for its care profile
factors.restSeason: Not watered in {{season}}: it's resting. Watering starts again on {{date}}
factors.restSeasonAlways: Its care profile doesn't need regular watering
factors.restSeasonAhead: The next watering would fall in its resting season, so it waits until {{date}}
factors.light: Light: about {{dli}} mol/m²/day here, where its care profile likes about {{expected}} at this time of year
factors.noLightIndoor: Light: not known yet. Add the windows or grow lights that reach it to refine this
factors.noLightOutdoor: Light: not known yet. Set its location's sun exposure to refine this
factors.noLocation: No location yet. Add one to take its light and temperature into account
factors.temperature: The room is about {{temperature}}; its care profile likes {{min}}–{{max}}
factors.inGround: Growing in the ground, which holds water longer
factors.dormant: Dormant, so it needs less water
factors.notLogged: Not logged yet, so counting from {{date}}
factors.fertilizePause: No fertilizing in {{months}}. It starts again on {{date}}
factors.neverFertilize: Its care profile doesn't need fertilizing
factors.dormantNoFertilizer: Dormant: no fertilizing until it grows again
factors.noCareProfile: No care profile: choose its species or a care profile
factors.rain: Rain: {{amount}} in the last two days, so the soil is still moist
factors.rainForecast: Rain forecast {{when}} ({{amount}}), so watering waits for it
factors.hotSpell: Hot spell: highs around {{max}}, above the {{ideal}} its care profile likes

amount.pot: About {{amount}} each time, or until a little drains from the bottom
amount.ground: About {{depth}} of water each time, as if that much rain fell
amount.groundGuess: About {{depth}} of water each time if it's in the ground, as if that much rain fell. In a pot, add the pot's size to see how much
amount.noPotSize: Add the pot's size to see how much water to give

today.title: Today
today.allCaughtUp: All caught up. Nothing needs care today.
today.nothingComingUp: Nothing else is due this week.
today.unscheduled_one: {{count}} plant has no care schedule yet.
today.unscheduled_other: {{count}} plants have no care schedule yet.
today.unscheduledAction: Open a plant to add its suggested routine.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.intro: Plugins add features to Sunfleck, such as weather. Turn them on for your household here.
plugins.problems: Some installed plugins couldn't be loaded
plugins.sendsData: When on, it sends data to:
plugins.secretSaved: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.

weather.frost: Frost likely {{when}} (low of {{low}}). Bring tender plants in, or cover them.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Get a daily digest of the care that's due, on your phone or by email. Sunfleck sends it through Apprise, which supports ntfy, Telegram, email, Discord, Signal and about 100 more.
notifications.noChannels: Add somewhere to send them, then send a test to check it works.
notifications.label: Name
notifications.urlHelp: For example ntfy://ntfy.sh/your-own-topic, tgram://bot-token/chat-id, or mailto://user:password@gmail.com. It's stored encrypted.
notifications.newUrlHelp: Leave empty to keep the current one. Addresses aren't shown again, since they often contain passwords or tokens.
notifications.deleteConfirm: Notifications won't be sent there any more.
notifications.digestHelp: What needs care today, and frost warnings. Not sent when there's nothing to do.
notifications.reminderHelp: Only what's still not done by then.
notifications.previewHelp: What it would say if it were sent now.
notifications.nothingToday: Nothing needs care today, so no digest would be sent.

identify.needsPhoto: Choose a photo to identify the plant from it.
identify.genusOnly: This species isn't in the care guide yet, but its genus is.
identify.notInGuide: Not in the care guide yet. You can still pick a care profile.
identify.noMatch: No plant was recognized. Try a closer photo of a leaf or flower.

install.title: Install Sunfleck
install.iosIntro: Add Sunfleck to your home screen to open it like an app:
install.iosShare: Tap the Share button in Safari (a square with an arrow).
install.iosAdd: Choose Add to Home Screen, then Add.

unreachable.title: Sunfleck can't be reached
unreachable.body: Check your internet connection, or whether the Sunfleck server is running, then try again.

data.title: Export and import
data.exportIntro: Download everything in this household as a ZIP file: places, plants, photos, care history and settings. Keep it as a backup, or import it into a new server.
data.exportLeftOut: Passwords, notification addresses and plugins' API keys aren't included.
data.importIntro: Load an export into this household. This works only while the household has no places or plants of its own, so nothing gets mixed up.
data.importNotAllowed: This household already has places or plants, so an export can't be imported into it. To move to a new server, download an export here and import it there.
data.fileHelp: A ZIP file downloaded from Sunfleck. Very large exports are best imported with the import_household command; see the docs.
data.unknownSpecies: Not in this server's care guide, so left without a species: {{items}}
data.unknownProfiles: Care profiles not on this server, so left unset: {{items}}
data.needKeys: Enter the API keys again under Plugins: {{items}}
data.notifications: Notification channels aren't exported: everyone sets theirs up again.
